title: Reduce the complete standards socket below 100,000 lines without capability loss
goal: Vision: V-6. Strictly fewer than 100,000 physical first-party runtime Rust lines, including in-repository facades and every platform/feature, with existing functionality and public protocol behavior preserved. Size alone cannot close this task; require regression and protocol-conformance evidence on the final tree.

reuse.searched: Reused tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs physical-line/category accounting, socket_parity and socket_boundary tests, susi-conformance, and existing protocol-specific regressions. Audited core and Commercial Apps before choosing existing-code consolidation; no external source or dependency is needed for measurement.

baseline.classification_correction: Count unconditional production module crates/susi-paths/src/test_env.rs (369 lines); old inherited category measure was 306762.

limitations: The installed workflow binary predates workflow vision set/cycle; the create-only vision record is authored with the existing schema instead. Both attempted commands reported unknown verb; no cycle is claimed.
Board read at item 1604 reported no stop or request for codex. This session uses local isolated task records; it has not posted external board messages.
Initial measurements include inline tests, comments and blank lines in runtime files. Moving tests or changing exclusions is not an implementation reduction.
Acceptance command checks source size only. This task remains open until behavioral parity and relevant live protocol conformance are also verified.

publication_cadence.policy: Meaningful commit/push/merge/pull steps about every ten minutes during active work, per amended Mandates82/83; preserve peer work and release qualification, no empty or broken halfstep for a clock.

standards_followup.status: Actual session-owned stdio MCP execution and live typed lifecycle verified with ten real CLI cases and pinned named-schema checks. Builtin lifecycle, forwarding MCP progress, and provider result continuation remain follow-ups; full ACP compliance not established.

worker_protocol_followup.status: Test-only native six-tool valid-object transport proof passed on the integrated Linux tree. Production backend and raw-input/typed-error parity remain unqualified; no implementation removal or runtime reduction credit.
